name: done-milestone-closeout-snapshot
title: Capture DONE milestone closeout snapshots
description: When a story reaches DONE, users need a stable milestone closeout table that records each milestone status, solved problem, done meaning, evidence, risks, and next action as accepted at closure time. The current milestone_status command is a live freshness view, so after DONE merge or version bump it can correctly report stale bindings while no longer serving as a final accepted closeout report.
